triage.missing_title:
Thanks for your interest! 🙏

The **product title** is missing. A clear title helps the factory understand your idea quickly.

Edit the issue with a short title and we’ll gladly review it again. ✨
triage.missing_description:
Thanks for the idea! 🌱

The description is missing or too short. Please add one or two lines about what the product does and who it helps.

Update the issue or open a new one — we’re ready when you are.
triage.external_links:
Thanks for the idea! 😊

It contains **external links**. Factory products work offline and must not depend on third-party sites, so links are not allowed at the idea stage.

Remove the links and resubmit — we’ll be happy to review it. 🚀
triage.dangerous_code:
Thanks for sharing.

This idea was declined because it includes executable code patterns (such as script tags or system commands). The factory only publishes safe static HTML pages.

Describe the idea in plain language without code and you’re welcome to try again.
triage.sensitive_data:
Thanks for the heads-up.

The text appears to contain sensitive data (keys or passwords). We don’t accept that content to protect the community.

Remove any secrets and resubmit if you’d like.
triage.generic_reject:
Thanks for the idea! 🙏

It didn’t pass automated triage this round. You can revise it based on factory guidelines and submit again.

We always welcome simple, offline-first ideas.
triage.approved:
Your idea was approved: **{title}** ✅

It’s on the weekly voting list. Add a 👍 on the ballot comment to support it.

Thank you for contributing to the micro-product factory! 🏭✨
